test_cases.title: WebGL 60FPS Frame Timing & Asset Loading
test_cases.expected: Canvas loads in < 2 seconds, runs at 60 FPS without memory leaks or blank fallbacks.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Zero unhandled JS exceptions in browser console.

test_cases.title: Auto-Pause Approval Gate State Management
test_cases.expected: Clicking PAUSE or reaching a Gate freezes simulation time, displays glowing PAUSED banner, and stops agent wander AI.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Game clock and agent movement stop completely when paused.

test_cases.title: Pixel-Matrix Sprite Sheet Atlas Mapping
test_cases.expected: All 10 characters render with unique pixel clothing, hair, and accessories (Cody backward cap, Jax rubber duck, Pixel beret, Aria purple hair).
test_cases.pass_criteria: Zero raw vector/rectangle shape fallbacks in sprite rendering.

test_cases.title: Top-Down 4-Direction Walking Leg Cycle Animation
test_cases.expected: Walking agents display 2-frame leg-stepping animation during movement.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Legs alternate positions during x/y displacement.

test_cases.title: Comic Dialogue Speech Bubble Rendering
test_cases.expected: Comic speech bubbles render over active agent head with pointer tail and typewriter text.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Bubble remains within canvas boundaries and text wraps properly.

test_cases.title: 16-Bit 44.1kHz Web Audio Synthesis & SFX Sync
test_cases.expected: Audio context initializes on mobile touch; SFX play in sync with dialogue blips, footstep, pool hit, and cheers.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Zero audio latency or distorted clipping.

test_cases.title: Beer Friday Dynamic Music Track Shift
test_cases.expected: Toggling Beer Friday Party Mode shifts theme to party rock MIDI and enables cheer SFX.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Party status badge pulses and audio synthesizer switches modes.

test_cases.title: Mobile Multi-Touch D-Pad & Action Responsiveness
test_cases.expected: Touch D-Pad moves Boss avatar smoothly on S10+ touchscreen; action buttons (TALK, POOL, PARTY, PAUSE) trigger instant responses.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Zero touch input lag or sticky button state.

test_cases.title: Interactive 9-Ball Billiards Physics Simulation
test_cases.expected: Tapping POOL shoots cue ball with friction deceleration and elastic cushion bank bounces.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Pool balls decelerate smoothly and bounce off felt borders.

test_cases.title: Simulated 24-Hour Day/Night Clock Loop
test_cases.expected: Clock advances from 08:00 AM to 05:00 PM and loops back properly.
